question: 7 males A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a row facing north (not necessarily in the same order). Only four males are to the left of A. B is the immediate neighbour of A and C. D is third to the left of E. F is not the immediate neighbour of E. What is the position of F from the right end of the row?
solution:
Given: Seven males A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a row facing north.

Only four males are to the left of A

B is the immediate neighbour of A and C.

D is third to the left of E.

F is not the immediate neighbour of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ada74de12691074f5c75cd13f42720434b163941a3dd4a528427f42a1d27d10b.png] 

So, F is 6th from the right end.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 3**.
